product_one_liner.value: Quantum Metric is a digital analytics platform for business, technology and analytics teams to capture customer behavior, diagnose friction and technical errors, and prioritize improvements to web and mobile experiences.

pricing_page.notes: Public pricing page describes custom plans tailored to scale and requirements.

eng_blog.notes: The main blog contains two technical posts by Senior Solutions Engineer Skyler Bailey covering MCP-server architecture and a working coding-agent integration prototype.

public_docs.notes: Public product documentation includes Felix Agentic Analyst guidance, analysis skills, workflows and MCP integration-token setup.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The readable careers page lists openings, but none has a qualifying AI, ML, data-science or related research title.

model_provider.notes: Felix Agentic explicitly identifies Google Gemini as part of its generative-AI foundation.

compliance_certs.notes: Claims SOC 2 attestation, ISO/IEC 27001 certification and GDPR compliance. GDPR is a compliance claim, not a certification; HIPAA and PCI references concern customers maintaining their own compliance.

last_funding.notes: Most recent disclosed round found; announced January 7, 2021.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest disclosed round was January 7, 2021, before the requested 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Live Strategic Account Executive, BFSI posting for the United States includes an application link.

launched_6mo.notes: On July 16, 2026, announced general availability of Felix Agentic and new mobile-crash and AI-traffic analytics capabilities.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: An update posted April 14, 2026 reports that Chief Marketing Officer Efrat Ravid left the company.

crm_stack_signal.notes: These systems are named in the VP, Global Growth Marketing job posting; this is a stack signal rather than confirmation of every deployed system.
